check: One row per calendar day for the whole period, keys unique
rationale: The calendar drives every time-based join.

check: product_id unique
evidence: 10 product IDs appear twice
rationale: Duplicate product rows multiply sales on join. Keep the record whose list price agrees with the price actually charged at the till in the latest year; the other copy is quarantined.

check: store_id unique and well formed
rationale: store_id is the join key for every fact table.

check: store + product + snapshot_date unique
rationale: Conflicting snapshots for one key cannot both be true.

check: return_id unique
rationale: Two different returns with one ID cannot both be kept.

check: transaction_id + line_number unique
evidence: 1,251 receipts re-sent
rationale: Re-sent receipt lines double-count revenue. Keep the earliest extracted copy; later copies are quarantined.

check: unit_price not about 100x the SKU reference price
evidence: price/reference ratio 100.0 to 100.0
rationale: A misplaced decimal point inflates revenue a hundredfold; price divided by 100 and revenue and margin recomputed.

check: Expected columns are present
evidence: all columns present
rationale: A missing column breaks every downstream load; the pipeline stops rather than guessing.

check: Every store has POS data for every trading day
evidence: 15 store-days missing from the main extract; 13 delivered by the late file; 2 still missing (S13 2024-10-15, S13 2024-10-16), estimated EUR 7,766
rationale: A store-day with no sales is a missing batch, not a closure, when stock and returns show trading. Gaps are reported and estimated, never filled with invented rows.

check: Derived attributes agree with the date (weekday, weekend, retail week)
rationale: Week-aligned YoY depends on the retail week mapping.

check: list_price and unit_cost positive
rationale: A negative cost is a sign error when its absolute value matches the cost charged at the till; corrected to the absolute value, otherwise flagged.

check: No exact duplicate rows
rationale: Duplicate snapshots double stock and sold units.

check: closing_stock not negative
evidence: 188 are exactly minus the identity value
rationale: Where the negative value is exactly minus the identity result, it is a sign error and is corrected.

check: Stock fields in range (no negatives other than adjustments)
rationale: Negative stock is physically impossible.

check: store_id and product_id exist in the dimensions
rationale: Orphan stock rows cannot be reported by store or product.

check: end_date on or after start_date
rationale: Dates restored from the same promotion's other rows (one promotion has one window); otherwise quarantined.

check: discount_pct between 0 and the maximum discount share
rationale: Promotion depth drives uplift and discount cost.

check: No exact duplicate rows
rationale: Duplicate returns overstate refunds and understate net revenue.

check: Linked sale line exists
evidence: 5 point to a store-day with no POS data at all (see TC-02); 139 point to a line number that does not exist
rationale: The refund was paid, so it stays in Returns Value, but it cannot be tied to a sale.

check: Return date after the sale date
rationale: A return before its sale is impossible as recorded; excluded from KPIs, value reported for review.

check: Returned quantity not above the quantity sold
rationale: More units returned than sold is impossible as recorded; excluded from KPIs, value reported for review.

check: Quantity and refund positive, reason and restockable flag valid, store and product known
rationale: Domain checks on every return.

check: transaction_date present, valid, in period and equal to the ID date
evidence: 100.0000% of valid in-period dates equal the ID date; malformed IDs: 0
rationale: The transaction ID is generated by the till and embeds the business date, so it is the authoritative source; every valid date in the file agrees with it.

check: store_id present, known and equal to the ID store
evidence: blank 669, unknown code 134, different known store 0
rationale: The transaction ID embeds the store; used to restore missing or unknown store IDs.

check: product_id present
evidence: 37 restored from the linked return, 1033 set to UNKNOWN
rationale: Restored from a return that references the same sale line (a second system record); otherwise mapped to UNKNOWN so revenue stays in totals but not in product analysis.

check: product_id exists in dim_product
evidence: 49 unknown product codes; 7 restored from the linked return, 260 set to UNKNOWN
rationale: Unknown product codes keep their revenue in totals under an UNKNOWN product member.

check: quantity positive (whole line sign-inverted)
rationale: Quantity, discount, revenue, cost and margin are all negated consistently, and returns are recorded in fact_returns, so these are sign errors. Evidence: the corrected units reconcile to the stock system.

check: quantity at or below the plausible maximum for a store line
evidence: quantities: 96, 120, 144, 250
rationale: Bulk quantities are not recorded as sold by the stock system; the true quantity cannot be recovered from the record, so the line is excluded from KPIs and kept for investigation.

check: unit_price above zero
evidence: 134 imputed; 28 with promotion depth; 0 without a reference price quarantined
rationale: A zero price with cost recorded is a pricing failure, not a giveaway. Price imputed from the SKU-year reference price, discount from the promotion depth (0 if not promoted); row flagged as imputed.

check: unit_price not negative (money fields sign-inverted)
rationale: Price, discount and revenue are negated consistently while quantity and cost are positive: a sign error.

check: revenue = quantity x unit_price - discount
evidence: 535 confirmed by cost + margin and corrected; 0 unconfirmed and quarantined
rationale: Where cost + margin also equals quantity x unit_price - discount, the components are confirmed and only revenue is wrong, so revenue is recomputed.

check: One store, date and time per transaction; line numbers 1..n
evidence: 0 receipts with mixed store/date/time; 0 with line-number gaps
rationale: Receipt-level integrity underpins transactions, AOV and UPT.

check: One target per store and retail week
evidence: 2 store-weeks with more than one target
rationale: Keep the latest target version (then latest set date); superseded versions are quarantined.

check: Target not an extreme outlier for the store
rationale: A target about 100x the store's median is a misplaced decimal point and is divided by 100; other outliers are quarantined.

check: Target positive and store known
rationale: A zero, negative or orphan target makes target achievement meaningless for that store-week.

check: Values parse to the contract type (blanks counted separately)
evidence: fact_sales.transaction_date: 3047
rationale: Type failures are counted per column in the profile; row-level handling is done by the specific rules below.

check: Sales batches arrive within the expected lag
evidence: 2,270 lines in the late file, extract lag 12 to 25 days; main extract lag 1 to 1 days; late lines sharing a key with the main extract: 0
rationale: Late files are valid sales delivered late. They are loaded with a flag so 'as first reported' and 'complete' figures can both be shown.

check: No missing week inside a store-SKU stock series
evidence: 462 series with an internal gap
rationale: Missing snapshots break availability and cover calculations; not imputed.

check: POS units equal stock-system sold units per store-SKU-week
evidence: match rate 98.4605% before cleaning, 99.4695% after (7,589 -> 2,610 store-SKU-weeks); remaining: sales line with UNKNOWN product in that store-week (FS-05/FS-06) 2157; missing stock snapshot (TC-05) 251; missing POS store-day (TC-02) 157; quarantined sales line (FS-09) 40; unexplained 3; flagged stock row (FI-04..FI-07) 2
rationale: Two independent systems must agree; the match rate before and after cleaning measures whether cleaning moved the data closer to the truth.

check: category is one of the 7 canonical categories
evidence: 'Home and Kitchen' -> 'Home & Kitchen'; 'HOME & KITCHEN' -> 'Home & Kitchen'; 'Home&Kitchen' -> 'Home & Kitchen'; 'Electronic & Tech' -> 'Electronics & Tech'; 'Electronics' -> 'Electronics & Tech'; 'HEALTH & BEAUTY' -> 'Health & Beauty'; 'Toys' -> 'Toys & Games'; 'Toys and Games' -> 'Toys & Games'; 'Garden' -> 'Garden & Outdoor'; 'GARDEN & OUTDOOR' -> 'Garden & Outdoor'
rationale: Label variants split categories in reporting; mapped to the canonical label (mapping logged).

check: supplier_id and supplier_name present
rationale: Supplier cannot be derived reliably (brands use several suppliers), so it is set to UNKNOWN and flagged.

check: unit_cost below list_price
rationale: Negative standard margin on the master record needs buyer review.

check: Launch/discontinuation dates and status consistent
rationale: Status drives range reporting; dates drive new-line and exit analysis.

check: Each subcategory belongs to one category
rationale: The product hierarchy must be a tree for drill-down.

check: Numeric attributes plausible (area, FTE, hours, coordinates in Ireland)
rationale: Store attributes feed per-m2 and per-FTE ratios.

check: received_qty present
evidence: 282 derived, 147 of them non-zero
rationale: Derived from the stock identity: closing - opening + sold - adjustment (must be >= 0).

check: closing = opening + received - sold + adjustment
evidence: 926 opening_stock corrected to the previous closing; 0 closing_stock corrected to the identity result; 14 unresolved and flagged
rationale: Triangulated with the neighbouring weeks: if previous closing + this week's movements = closing, and closing = next week's opening, the opening is wrong (set to previous closing). If the identity result = next week's opening, the closing is wrong (set to the identity result). Otherwise flagged; the true field is unknown.

check: opening_stock equals the previous week's closing_stock
evidence: tested after FI-06 corrections
rationale: Continuity breaks point to an unrecorded movement or a corrupted snapshot.

check: Snapshot is a Sunday and matches the retail week
rationale: Weekly snapshots must line up with the retail calendar.

check: No exact duplicate rows
rationale: Duplicate promotion rows would double promotion counts.

check: One name, type and window per promotion_id
evidence: none; 7 promotions use more than one depth (types: Clearance), accepted as tiered pricing
rationale: Promotion header attributes should be identical on every row. Depth may legitimately vary (tiered clearance), so it is reported, not flagged.

check: product_id and store_id exist in the dimensions
evidence: 3 of 3 restored from POS lines
rationale: Rows for unknown products cannot be analysed; restored only if the POS lines identify the product (see FS-20).

check: Refund not above the sale line value for the units returned
rationale: Over-refunds need finance review; kept because the money was paid.

check: Returned product equals the product on the sale line
rationale: A mismatch means the link or the product is wrong.

check: Return within the returns policy window
rationale: 30 days, extended to 31 January for Christmas purchases.

check: transaction_date in ISO format (yyyy-mm-dd)
evidence: every legacy date equals the ID date
rationale: Legacy dd/mm/yyyy dates are converted; each is confirmed against the date inside the transaction ID.

check: unit_price present
rationale: Derived as (revenue + discount) / quantity and confirmed against the SKU reference price.

check: unit_price within 1% of the SKU-year reference price
rationale: Each SKU sells at one list price per year (discounts are recorded separately); other deviations need review.

check: discount present
evidence: 271 of the restored discounts are non-zero
rationale: Derived as quantity x unit_price - revenue (revenue and price are present and valid).

check: discount between 0 and the maximum discount share of gross
rationale: Negative or excessive discounts after sign correction need review.

check: margin = revenue - cost and cost = quantity x unit_cost
evidence: cost != quantity x unit_cost on 0
rationale: Margin is recomputed after any revenue correction.

check: promotion_id exists in fact_promotions
evidence: 49 unknown codes; 58 restored from the one active promotion whose depth matches the discount; 208 cleared (no discount, so not a promoted line); 1 set to UNKNOWN
rationale: Restored when exactly one promotion is active for that store, product and date and its depth matches the line discount; cleared when the line has no discount (it was not promoted); otherwise UNKNOWN.

check: Promoted line's store and product are in that promotion
evidence: 242 promoted lines on the UNKNOWN product cannot be tested; 35 lines resolved by restoring 3 promotion rows (FP-04)
rationale: Either the promotion file is incomplete or the till applied the wrong promotion. Where a promotion row was quarantined for an invalid product code (FP-04) and the POS lines of that promotion and store point to exactly one missing product, the promotion row is restored with that product (two records agree).

check: No sales before launch or more than a week after discontinuation
rationale: Sales outside the product life cycle point to a master-data date error.

check: Week dates match the retail calendar
rationale: Targets must join to the calendar on retail year and week.

check: Store-day revenue not far below the store's usual level
rationale: A partial batch looks like a very low trading day.

check: One extract batch per business day, loaded next morning
evidence: 729 daily batches; batches covering more than one business day: 0; batches with lines extracted at more than one hour (re-sends): 571; extract hours seen: [2, 5]
rationale: Batch structure is the first sign of a missing or re-sent file.

check: A target for every store and retail week
rationale: Missing targets make target achievement undefined for that store-week; not imputed.

check: Text fields without leading or trailing spaces
rationale: Trailing spaces break name matching and look like different products.

check: product_name unique across product IDs
evidence: 18 names shared by 2+ IDs
rationale: Two IDs with one name may be genuine variants or a re-coded SKU; reported for review, not merged.

check: Text fields without leading or trailing spaces
rationale: Padded names create duplicate labels in reports and failed joins on name.

check: region, store_format in the canonical domain
rationale: A case variant of a region splits that region into two rows in every regional report.

check: Quantities stored as whole numbers
evidence: columns stored with decimals: received_qty
rationale: Unit quantities exported as decimals (0.0) are cast to integers.

check: POS category label equals the product master category
evidence: 0 lines whose standardised POS label names a different category; variants: 'TOYS & GAMES', 'Home&Kitchen', 'Home and Kitchen', 'Stationary & Crafts', 'Electronics', 'SEASONAL & GIFTS', 'Gifts & Seasonal', 'Health/Beauty', 'Stationery and Crafts', 'Seasonal and Gifts', 'Seasonal', 'Toys', 'Health & Beauty ', 'Health and Beauty', 'Electronics & Tech ', 'HEALTH & BEAUTY', 'Electronic & Tech', 'Stationery', 'Home & Kitchen ', 'Garden', 'HOME & KITCHEN', 'Garden & Outdoors', 'STATIONERY & CRAFTS', 'Toys & Games ', 'Garden and Outdoor', 'ELECTRONICS & TECH', 'Toys and Games', 'GARDEN & OUTDOOR'
rationale: The POS category text is denormalised; the product master is the source of truth.

check: Promoted line carries a discount
rationale: A promotion with no discount has no promotional effect.

check: Promoted line falls within the promotion dates
rationale: Promotion applied outside its window.

check: Retail weeks have 7 days (partial week at extract end)
evidence: retail 2026 wk 1: 3 days
rationale: 29-31 Dec 2025 belong to retail 2026 week 1, outside the 104 comparable weeks.

check: Promotion window inside the extract period
evidence: latest end 2026-01-04
rationale: Promotions that straddle the period end are valid.

check: Return linked to an original sale
evidence: 3.0% of returns have no receipt
rationale: No-receipt returns are allowed (BRD assumption 2); they stay in Returns Value.

check: Returned at a different store from the sale
rationale: Allowed by policy (BRD assumption 2: returns are recorded where they are returned).

check: Linked sale only exists in the late sales file
rationale: Resolved by loading the late file (TC-01).

check: Discount without a promotion_id (non-promotional markdown)
evidence: discount / gross on these lines: 10% (5423), 20% (5365), 15% (5291)
rationale: Damaged-box and price-match markdowns are legitimate and are not promotions.

check: Line unit_cost differs from the product master cost
evidence: 99.9% of 2024 lines, 0.0% of 2025 lines
rationale: The master holds the current standard cost; the till records the cost of the day (history).

check: Negative line margin
evidence: 100.0% of them are discounted lines
rationale: Clearance and deep promotions can sell below cost.

check: Line price check impossible (UNKNOWN product, no reference price)
rationale: Recorded for transparency: these lines cannot be price-checked.
